an5.27:1.4: āyatiñca → āyatiṁ ca (bj, sya-all) | paccattaññeva → paccattaṁ yeva (bj)

an5.27:1.8: sato → so (bj, sya-all) | imaṁ → imaṁ samādhiṁ sato va (bj); imaṁ samādhiṁ satova (sya-all) | vuṭṭhahāmīti paccattaññeva → va uṭṭhahāmīti paccattaṁ yeva (bj)
